title: Continuous Health Monitoring
description_brief: We are developing wearable electrochemical sensors that can continuously monitor physiological markers.
description_detailed: Our lab is pioneering the next generation of wearable technology. Beyond simple step counting, we utilize aptamer-based sensing to detect specific biomarkers like glucose, cortisol, and lactate in real-time.

title: Rapid Infectious Disease Diagnostics
description_brief: Our lab engineers rapid, point-of-care diagnostic tools for detecting bacterial and viral infections.
description_detailed: Addressing the global challenge of antimicrobial resistance, we are engineering diagnostic platforms that combine DNA nanotechnology with electronic readout.

title: Smart Materials & Bio-Interfaces
description_brief: We study how nanostructured materials interact with biological systems.
description_detailed: The interface between a device and the body is critical. We synthesize novel nanostructured materials that can repel bacteria while enhancing sensitivity.
